column1: # DWB-667 COVERAGE BASELINE. Written 2026-10-09, FROZEN BEFORE THE AFTER-RUN.
# WHAT THIS IS FOR. The after-number on its own cannot distinguish two causes
# with opposite meanings:
#   a situation that HAS a covering lesson and still recalls nothing
#       -> a KEYWORD failure, which is what DWB-667 is about
#   a situation that has NO covering lesson
#       -> the corpus has nothing to say and reporting nothing is CORRECT
# So the result is reported as two numbers against two denominators rather than
# one number against a guess. This file is the denominator, and it is written
# and frozen BEFORE the after-run so it cannot be adjusted to fit the result.
# HOW EACH VERDICT WAS REACHED. For each of the 30 frozen situations in
# dwb667_situations.tsv, every scar belonging to that agent was read and judged:
# is any of them GENUINELY ABOUT this moment? Judged from `condensed` ONLY -
# never from keywords, which are the thing under measurement and were being
# rewritten while this was written. `condensed` is untouched by the rekey route
# (verified: it is not a parameter, the schema forbids the key, and the AST
# guard asserts rekey_memory never assigns it), so the judgement is stable
# whenever it is taken.
# WHO WROTE IT, SO A READER CAN DISCOUNT IT. Devin_DWB (188) wrote the 30
# situations AND judged this coverage. That is one person on both sides of the
# measurement and it should be read that way. The mitigation is that it is
# per-situation and cites the row ids, so any verdict can be checked against the
# store by someone who disagrees. Devin is the only agent not re-keywording,
# which is why the job fell here.
# THE THREE VERDICTS WERE DECLARED BEFORE ANY WERE ASSIGNED:
#   covered     at least one scar is squarely about this moment. Row ids cited.
#   borderline  a scar is adjacent but is about a different thing. NOT resolved
#               either way on purpose - a third bucket declared in advance is
#               honest, one invented after the number lands is not.
#   none        nothing in this agent's corpus is about this moment.
# A FOURTH CLASS WAS CHECKED FOR AND IS EMPTY, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED. A situation
# supplying fewer than _MATCH_TOKENS_REQUIRED usable tokens is unreachable by
# construction, whatever any keyword says. Across these 30: ZERO. The minimum
# usable-token count in the set is 8 and the maximum is 15.
# A NOTE ON THAT CLASS, because the report that prompted the check named it
# differently and the difference changes which bucket a row lands in. The two
# cited examples were measured: "the README is out of date, can you fix it"
# supplies 6 usable tokens, and "I used diff to check the two files" supplies 6.
# Neither is a situation that cannot be reached. What was short in both was the
# OVERLAP between the sentence and the keyword set - ['readme','stale'] lands one
# token where ['readme','out of date'] lands three, and ['cmp','diff'] lands one
# where ['diff','files'] lands two. That is a KEYWORD failure, which is the
# bucket this ticket is about, not a structural limit of the situation. The
# remedy both authors found - widen the set - is right either way; only the
# label moves, and it moves the row from "correct behaviour, nothing to do" into
# "the thing we are fixing".
# Format: <agent_id>\t<verdict>\t<covering row ids or ->\t<situation>

column1: # TOTALS: 27 covered, 3 borderline, 0 none, 0 unreachable-by-construction.
# WHAT THAT MEANS FOR THE RESULT, stated now rather than after the number:
#   The probe set is NOT the problem. 27 of 30 situations have a lesson that is
#   squarely about them and 3 more have something adjacent. The baseline recalled
#   4. So at least 23 situations hold a covering lesson that the keywords failed
#   to reach, and that is the quantity DWB-667 is trying to move.
#   The honest ceiling for the after-run is therefore 27/30, not 30/30, and a
#   result between 27 and 30 would mean something had gone wrong rather than
#   right: a borderline situation firing is as likely to be a coincidence match
#   as a real recall, and should be inspected rather than counted.
#   The per-agent denominators are 13:4+2, 14:5+1, 21:6, 28:6, 38:6. Barry (21)
#   is the sharpest single case in the set: 6 of 6 covered and 0 of 6 recalled
#   at baseline, with the most concrete-looking keywords on the team. If the
#   contract is right, his number should move the furthest.
